description: Special tutorial designed to provide Chemistry 12 background.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of the following
    • Chemistry 11
    • Complete 1 of the following
      • Complete all of:
        • MATH120 - Precalculus Mathematics (1.5)
      • Pre-Calculus 12
      • Principles of Mathematics 12
    • or permission of the department.
supplementalNotes:
• For students intending to enrol, either simultaneously or subsequently, in an university-level introductory general chemistry course.
  • Students who have completed an advanced mathematics course equivalent to Pre-Calculus 12 or Principles of Mathematics 12 may request permission to register in the course.
  • 0.5 fee unit.
title: Introduction to Chemistry
